title: Public Firewall Profile is Disabled
description: The Windows Firewall Public profile protects the host when connected to untrusted networks (e.g., public Wi-Fi, coffee shops, hotels).
impact: Unsolicited inbound connections and malicious scanning probes from adjacent hosts on public networks can access local ports.
remediation_guidance: Enable Public firewall: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Public -Enabled True

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Public: Firewall state' is set to 'On'

title: Domain Firewall Profile is Disabled
description: The Windows Firewall Domain profile enforces boundary controls when connected to corporate Active Directory networks.
impact: Lateral movement attacks across domain joined endpoints can succeed unrestricted.
remediation_guidance: Enable Domain firewall: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain -Enabled True

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Domain: Firewall state' is set to 'On'

title: Private Firewall Profile is Disabled
description: The Windows Firewall Private profile enforces rules for private home/work networks.
impact: Compromised local devices (e.g. smart IoT devices) can probe and exploit the workstation.
remediation_guidance: Enable Private firewall: Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Private -Enabled True

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state' is set to 'On'

title: Default Inbound Action is Allowed on Public Profile
description: Inbound connections on the public profile must default to Block to prevent unsolicited network access.
impact: All incoming ports without explicit blocking rules are open by default.
